contentText: French Defence Minister Catherine Vautrin and her British counterpart John Healey will co-chair a multinational meeting Tuesday on military plans to restore trade flows through the blocked Strait of Hormuz after the Iran war ends. The virtual meeting of dozens of defence ministers comes as President Donald Trump warned the US-Iran ceasefire was on “life support”. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
